priorityList: Ensure your pet is summoned before combat starts.
Use offensive Racials (like Berserking or Blood Fury) and Potions when Bestial Wrath is ready or active.
Use active Trinkets (such as Algethar Puzzle Box or Light Company Guidon) when Bestial Wrath is ready or active.
Cast Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath is about to come off cooldown (less than 1 GCD remaining).
Cast Wild Thrash as your top priority for AoE damage and to trigger Beast Cleave.
Cast Kill Command whenever it is available as your primary rotational ability.
Prioritize Kill Command even more when Nature's Ally (Sentinel Owl) is active.
Cast Cobra Shot if the Hogstrider buff is active and you are fighting fewer than 4 targets.
Cast Barbed Shot to maintain Frenzy stacks on your pet and to prevent the ability from reaching maximum charges.
Use Cobra Shot as a filler when Wild Thrash and Kill Command are both on cooldown.
